title: Church Attendance Trend by Month
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:attendance service_type=* attended=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(attended="yes",1,0))) as metric by _time service_type
| sort 0 _time service_type
description: Trends monthly attended services by service type for church attendance.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether church attendance are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `service_type` on `faith:attendance` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly attended services.
visualization: Line chart of monthly attended services by service type.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how attended services changes month by month for each service type so you can see whether church attendance are heading the right way.
